theme.disclosure: Interface palettes are a Premium feature. Your choice is saved to your CoutureCast account and applies on every device you sign in on. A palette changes colours only: it never changes which outfits are recommended. CoutureCast sends the palette you picked to its analytics provider under a pseudonymous id; no wardrobe photos or personal details are shared.
